test_title: RRB Group D 2025 (New Pattern) Official Mock Test
subject: general
question: The Indian government launched a new digital health initiative in 2025, to improve healthcare accessibility and interoperability of medical data. What is the name of this initiative?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission 2.0**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) 2.0** is an advanced version of the original **Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission**, launched in **2021**. This initiative is aimed at improving healthcare accessibility and ensuring **seamless interoperability of medical data**.
 
• The **ABDM 2.0**, launched in **2025**, is a flagship healthcare initiative by the **Indian Government** to transform healthcare delivery through the integration of **digital health infrastructure**.
 
• **Interoperability:** The mission focuses on creating a **digital health ecosystem** where patient records, diagnostics, and treatment details are accessible to healthcare providers, ensuring smoother operations and better patient outcomes.
 
• **Components:** The initiative includes a **unique health ID** for every citizen, a healthcare professionals registry, and a health facility registry to connect doctors, hospitals, and other healthcare providers seamlessly.
 
• The initiative also aims to integrate various health schemes like **Ayushman Bharat–Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)**, state health programs, and private health insurance plans for better coordination and utilization of resources.
 
• **Technology:** ABDM 2.0 incorporates technologies like **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** and **Machine Learning (ML)** for predictive analysis, telemedicine, and remote monitoring, making healthcare accessible to rural and remote areas.
 
• **Data Security:** A robust data security framework is an integral part of ABDM 2.0 to ensure the privacy and confidentiality of patient information. It complies with the **Data Protection Bill** and follows global standards.
 
• This initiative aligns with the overarching vision of **Digital India**, which aims to transform India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy.
 
• By bridging the gap between various stakeholders in the healthcare ecosystem, **ABDM 2.0** ensures **universal healthcare access** and promotes inclusivity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM):**

 
 
• The **original ABDM** was launched on **September 27, 2021**, with the aim of creating a unified digital health infrastructure in India.
 
• It introduced the concept of a **unique health ID**, which acts as a repository of an individual’s health records, accessible anytime and anywhere.
 
• The mission promotes the use of a **standardized platform** for healthcare providers and consumers to share information seamlessly.
 
 
 
• **Digital Healthcare in India:**
 
 
• The Indian government has been focusing on adopting digital technologies across sectors to improve access and efficiency, as part of the **Digital India initiative**.
 
• In the healthcare sector, digital transformation includes **e-Sanjeevani** (telemedicine service), **CO-WIN platform** (for COVID-19 vaccinations), and various state-level health initiatives.
 
 
 
• **Significance of ABDM 2.0:**
 
 
• It ensures better integration of public and private healthcare services, reducing redundancy and ensuring efficient use of resources.
 
• It provides a seamless interface for patients to access their medical records, book appointments, and avail teleconsultation services.
 
• It empowers healthcare professionals with real-time access to patient medical history, enabling them to make informed decisions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Options:**

 
 
• **Digital India Healthcare 2025:** While related to the **Digital India** campaign, this is a fictional name and not an actual initiative.
 
• **National Health Stack Expansion:** The **National Health Stack** is an existing initiative aimed at creating a digital infrastructure for healthcare, but it is not the name of the 2025 initiative in question.
 
• **Bharat AI Health Grid:** While AI in healthcare is gaining traction, this option refers to a hypothetical initiative and is not related to the **2025 digital health mission**.
 
 
 
• **Global Context:**
 
 
• Countries like **Estonia** and **Singapore** have implemented robust digital health ecosystems, serving as inspiration for India's initiatives.
 
• The **World Health Organization (WHO)** has been emphasizing the role of digital health in achieving **Universal Health Coverage (UHC)**.
